name: OneUptime
description: Lets AI assistants investigate incidents, query logs and traces, acknowledge alerts, and set up monitors in OneUptime, an open-source observability platform, via remote MCP.

skills.name: Monitors
skills.description: Creates and configures monitors, checks their status, and reviews their history.

skills.name: Incident Response
skills.description: Creates, acknowledges, and resolves incidents, adds internal or public notes, and manages teams and on-call policies.

skills.name: Alerts
skills.description: Acknowledges and resolves alerts, adds notes, and manages alert states and severities.

skills.name: Status Pages and Maintenance
skills.description: Manages status pages, posts announcements, and creates scheduled maintenance events.

skills.name: Telemetry Queries
skills.description: Queries logs, metrics, traces, exceptions, monitor logs, and security events, read-only.
